methodology: This story is generated from Netflix's public all-weeks global Top 10 TSV for Films (English). The latest frame mirrors the source Top 10 rows for the configured category and week; prior frames show those same current Top 10 titles when they appeared in the preceding weeks. Facade artwork uses Netflix Tudum's public Top 10 card image when available, cropped to a portrait atlas tile; poster and boxshot URLs are retained as secondary reference artwork.
